Each row is one evenly spaced expiry; color encodes implied volatility across strike/forward moneyness. Blank cells fall outside the listed strike range.
Fair value uses Black-76 with a leave-one-out local quadratic fit of neighboring Derive mark IVs. Derive mark and live quotes remain separate observations.
Deviation is observed price minus fitted fair value. Bid/ask points appear only when live quotes exist; missing quotes are never treated as zero.
